units.issue: notice and dispute procedure for sub-tenancy
units.date_scope: Distinguishes sub-letting after commencement of the Act from lawful sub-letting before commencement; creation and termination notices have specified one-month or six-month periods.
units.procedure_scope: Tenant or sub-tenant may give prescribed notice to the landlord; for contested pre-Act lawful sub-letting, landlord or sub-tenant may apply to the Controller within the specified two-month period, and the Controller decides the dispute.

conditions.text: For post-commencement sub-letting, the premises must have been sub-let in whole or part with the landlord's previous written consent.
conditions.quote: after the commencement of this Act, any premises are sub-let either in whole or in part by the tenant with the previous consent in writing of the landlord

conditions.text: For post-commencement sub-letting, the tenant or sub-tenant may give prescribed notice of creation within one month of sub-letting and notify termination within one month of termination.
conditions.quote: give notice to the landlord of the creation of the sub-tenancy within one month of the date of such sub-letting and notify the termination of such sub- tenancy within one month of such termination

conditions.text: For pre-commencement lawful sub-letting, the tenant or sub-tenant may give prescribed notice of creation within six months of commencement and notify termination within one month of termination.
conditions.quote: before the commencement of this Act, any premises have been lawfully sub-let either in whole or in part by the tenant

conditions.text: If the landlord contests lawful sub-letting in a case under subsection (2), an application by the landlord or sub-tenant must be made to the Controller within two months of the relevant notice event for the Controller to decide the dispute.
conditions.quote: the landlord contests that the premises were not lawfully sub-let, and an application is made to the Controller in this behalf, either by the landlord or by the sub-tenant, within two months of the date of the receipt of the notice of sub-letting by the landlord or the issue of the notice by the tenant or the sub-tenant

units.issue: direct tenancy status of protected sub-tenants
units.date_scope: Subsection (1) operates from the date of a section 14 eviction order; subsection (2) covers tenant interests determined before commencement of the Act and operates from the date of commencement.
units.procedure_scope: Specifies when a qualifying sub-tenant is deemed to become a tenant holding directly under the landlord and the terms of that deemed tenancy.

conditions.text: An eviction order under section 14 must be made against the tenant but not against the sub-tenant referred to in section 17.
conditions.quote: an order for eviction in respect of any premises is made under section 14 against a tenant but not against a sub-tenant referred to in section 17

conditions.text: Notice of the sub-tenancy must have been given to the landlord.
conditions.quote: a notice of the sub-tenancy has been given to the landlord

conditions.text: When the subsection (1) conditions are met, the sub-tenant becomes a direct tenant from the date of the eviction order for the premises occupied, on the same terms and conditions the tenant would have had if the tenancy continued.
conditions.quote: the sub-tenant shall, with effect from the date of the order, be deemed to become a tenant holding directly under the landlord in respect of the premises in his occupation on the same terms and conditions on which the tenant would have held from the landlord, if the tenancy had continued

conditions.text: For the pre-commencement route, the tenant's interest must have been determined before commencement without determining the interest of a sub-tenant to whom the premises had been lawfully sub-let.
conditions.quote: before the commencement of this Act, the interest of a tenant in respect of any premises has been determined without determining the interest of any sub-tenant to whom the premises either in whole or in part had been lawfully sub-let

conditions.text: When the subsection (2) condition is met, the sub-tenant is deemed from commencement of the Act to hold directly under the landlord on the same terms and conditions the tenant would have had if the tenancy continued.
conditions.quote: the sub-tenant shall, with effect from the date of the commencement of this Act, be deemed to have become a tenant holding directly under the landlord on the same terms and conditions on which the tenant would have held from the landlord, if the tenancy had continued
